Bluesounder interprets the existing radio transmissions from these baitboats and passes them to an iPhone or iPad to display a much more detailed image with choice of colour schemes. The display can be frozen, swiped back in time so that the last few minutes of depth profile can be reviewed and the units and zoom levels can all be changed to suit the user and conditions.
